answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy anchors trust in proof-of-attention: every identity stakes reputation at the vertex of a social graph and vouches for neighbors it can verify. Forgery cost scales with the graph, because an attacker must win over established nodes instead of minting fresh wallets at dawn. Honest clusters climb to the summit of credibility while disposable clones stay stranded at the edges, priced out of every transaction that matters.
